race.comment: SCRIPTED (13) peaked on the run second up when she gave weight to TRANSCEND for a close up third over 1500m at this track. Gets the services of Rawiller and the addition of winkers can do the trick. No shock to see her turn the tables. TRANSCEND (8) starting to hit her straps after she sat outside the leader to get up in a thrilling finish over this course and distance third up. Has further improvement and can stalk the good tempo. BESIDE THE OCEAN (10) slashing performance at her second run back when carving out slick closing splits to run fourth to TRANSCEND. Gets a more genuine tempo here. Has top three prospects. MR VERSE (3) shouldered the 60kg second up for a respectable fifth over 1400m at this track from a wide gate. Gets a better set up and will be doing his best work late. SILVANITO (6) holding his form and gets map favours at the good each way price.
